{{Quote|Meerko want big-bad armor-man gone! He and friends make all Meerko Clan fear. Make much trouble for droid-part sandcrawler trade-sell. Take all Meerko Clan stuff!|Meerko|<ref name="BC1">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Bounty Contract: Tatooine|Tatooine}}</ref><ref name="BC2">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Bounty Contract: Tatooine|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Meerko Clan''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] clan led by [[Meerko]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Kreegan Ramar]] began targeting the clan, leading Meerko to hire a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] from the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to deal with Ramar.
